counterexample_decisive.final_query:
; ============================================================
; Pairwise Query: Pair (0,0)
; Case1[1]: (param_1 < 0) AND (param_2 != 0)
; Case2[0]: unconditional
; ============================================================

(set-logic QF_BV)

; ----------------------------------------
; Parameters for fc_guarded_call
; (Bit widths from Ghidra analysis)
; ----------------------------------------
(declare-const param_1_1 (_ BitVec 32))  ; signed
(declare-const param_2_1 (_ BitVec 32))  ; signed

; ----------------------------------------
; Parameters for fc_equiv_direct
; (Bit widths from Ghidra analysis)
; ----------------------------------------
(declare-const param_1_2 (_ BitVec 32))  ; signed
(declare-const param_2_2 (_ BitVec 32))  ; signed

; ----------------------------------------
; Parameter equality constraints
; For matching bit widths: direct equality unless semantic narrowing is inferred
; For different bit widths: overlapping bits equal, upper bits free
; ----------------------------------------
; param_1_1 and param_1_2: same width (32bit)
(assert (= param_1_1 param_1_2))
; param_2_1 and param_2_2: same width (32bit)
(assert (= param_2_1 param_2_2))

; ----------------------------------------
; Case1[1] conditions
; ----------------------------------------
(assert (bvslt param_1_1 (_ bv0 32)))
(assert (distinct param_2_1 (_ bv0 32)))

; ----------------------------------------
; Value inequality
; ----------------------------------------
(assert (not (= (bvsub (_ bv0 32) (bvsdiv param_1_1 param_2_1)) (bvadd (bvadd param_1_2 param_2_2) (_ bv5 32)))))

(check-sat)
(get-model)
